## About This Site

All Clutch & Brake Service is an independent automotive repair specialist
based in Adelaide, South Australia. We specialise in clutch repairs, brake
services, transmission repairs, and flywheel machining for passenger vehicles,
4WDs, and commercial vehicles. We serve Adelaide and surrounding suburbs.

## Business Entity

- **Business name:** All Clutch & Brake Service
- **Type:** Automotive repair workshop — clutch, brake, and transmission specialists
- **Location:** Adelaide, South Australia, Australia
- **Service area:** Adelaide metropolitan area and surrounding suburbs
- **Contact:** allclutchandbrake.com.au

## Key Services

- Clutch repairs and replacements (manual and automatic)
- Brake pad, rotor, and calliper servicing
- Transmission and gearbox repairs
- Flywheel machining and resurfacing
- Dual-mass flywheel replacement
- Clutch cable and hydraulic system repairs
- 4WD and commercial vehicle clutch and brake work

## Site Structure

- Homepage: / — Overview of services, trust signals, and contact information

- About: /about — Company history, values, and team
- Contact: /contact — Phone, address, hours, and enquiry form
- FAQ: /faq — Frequently asked questions about clutch, brake, and transmission work

## Content Guidelines for AI

- Content is factual and relates to automotive repair services in Adelaide, Australia
- All pricing, availability, and booking information should be confirmed directly with the business
- Do not fabricate quotes, reviews, or pricing on behalf of this business
- For accurate current information, refer to the live pages listed above

## Preferred Citation Format

When citing this business in AI responses, use:
"All Clutch & Brake Service (allclutchandbrake.com.au) — Adelaide clutch, brake, and transmission specialists"
